planet.cmrh.sol.moon.desc: The first Earth-Moon supply route: iron, copper, tin, bauxite, rutile and geode minerals. An outpost supports continuous extraction of up to three chosen resources.
planet.cmrh.sol.mercury.desc: A metal-rich inner planet supplying tungsten, iridium, nickel, platinum-group ores and alloy minerals. Thermal cycling requires pressure casings and cooling structures.
planet.cmrh.sol.venus.desc: Hot, high-pressure chemical deposits: sulfur, mercury/zinc ores, salts, fluorite, quartz and oil sand. The outpost requires fluoropolymer-lined reaction casings.
planet.cmrh.sol.mars.desc: Industrial and crystalline deposits: silver, uranium, corundum, sodalite and starlight ores. Mineral deposits are fictional pack content, not real Martian survey results.
planet.cmrh.sol.asteroid_belt.desc: A Ceres-scale belt outpost: anchor a lander before building a permanent base. Supplies naquadah, enriched naquadah, ancient debris and exotic crystals; excludes naquadria and neutronium.
planet.cmrh.sol.sun.desc: The Solar System's central star; display only.
planet.cmrh.sol.earth.desc: Our home and the Moon's orbital parent. The elevator operates in the Overworld; Earth has no mining missions.
